sections.title: Generate from the last known position

provenance: The core runs offline. The frozen hand-chosen image encoder is Vision I's exact five-token worksheet. A three-coordinate connector and prefix decoder are fitted to only two grid/answer pairs; all displayed arithmetic and generated choices are recomputed. This is not a pretrained VLM or a general counting model. The toy omits LayerNorm, FFN and dropout.
